title: The Element Discovered Before It Existed on Earth
hook: How do you discover something 93 million miles away before finding it at home?
script: In 1868, astronomers first discovered helium on the Sun during a solar eclipse. They spotted an unusual yellow line at 587.49 nanometers in the solar spectrum. This discovery was so groundbreaking that it took 27 years to isolate helium on Earth. Sir William Ramsay finally did this in 1895 by treating uranium-bearing cleveite with sulfuric acid. Helium, named after the Greek sun god Helios, constitutes about 24% of the elemental mass in the universe. Yet, it makes up just 0.00052% of Earth's atmosphere due to its lightness. The next time you inhale helium, remember it was first seen in the sky, not the ground.
